title: LeapDeviceManifest
description: Implementation-independent LEAP profile/device manifest. Manifest content MUST be consistent with LEAP-DIR objects and endpoint descriptors; live LEAP-DIR responses take precedence on conflict.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this manifest schema (e.g. '1.0'). Required per §22 versioning requirement.

vendor_id.description: 16-bit vendor identifier. Aligned with LeapIdentity.vendor_id on the wire.

product_code.description: 32-bit product code. Aligned with LeapIdentity.product_code on the wire.

serial_number.description: 32-bit serial number. Instance-specific; optional in the manifest since it can be read at runtime from LeapIdentity via LEAP-DISC or LEAP-DIR. Include when the manifest is generated per-unit rather than per-model.

product_name.description: Human-readable product name. Corresponds to the DEVICE_NAME TLV (0x0002).

hardware_revision.description: 16-bit hardware revision. Aligned with LeapIdentity.hardware_revision on the wire.

firmware_revision.description: 16-bit firmware revision. Aligned with LeapIdentity.firmware_revision on the wire.

revision.description: Product or device revision as exposed by the REVISION TLV (0x0005). Maximum 65535 to match the 16-bit wire representation.

supported_services.description: Array of supported 16-bit LEAP service IDs. Matches the packed uint16_t[] list in HELLO_REPLY and the SUPPORTED_SERVICES TLV.

default_profile_id.description: 32-bit profile ID of the default active profile after boot. Corresponds to LeapHelloReply.default_profile_id and LEAP_TLV_DEFAULT_PROFILE_ID. Must be non-zero and present in the profiles array.

profile_id.description: 32-bit LEAP profile ID. Must be non-zero; 0x00000000 is LEAP_PROFILE_NONE and MUST NOT appear as an active profile entry. Standard IDs are defined in leap_protocol.h; vendor profiles start at 0x80000000.

input_size_bytes.description: Total byte size of the device-to-controller endpoint payload for this profile.

output_size_bytes.description: Total byte size of the controller-to-device endpoint payload for this profile.

type.description: Wire data type for this channel. INT32 supports 32-bit signed fields. RAW marks an opaque byte block and requires size_bytes or bit_width.

bit_offset.description: Absolute bit offset of the channel within the process data image (bit 0 = LSB of byte 0). Byte-aligned types must have bit_offset divisible by 8.

size_bytes.description: Byte length of the channel value. Required when type is RAW; indicates the byte length of the raw block.

bit_width.description: Bit width of the channel value. Required when type is RAW and size_bytes is not provided. Also used for sub-byte or partial-word fields.

direction.description: Data flow direction. INPUT = device-to-controller, OUTPUT = controller-to-device, DIAGNOSTIC = status/diagnostic within the process data image.
